correctness.rationale: The full primary antisquare classification implies the only configurations beyond the eight-pattern SFT are complement/shift translates of two nonperiodic heteroclinic sequences; they contribute neither periodic points nor invariant probability mass. Independent de Bruijn reconstruction gives 20 admissible five-block states, 28 edges, two closed complementary primitive strongly connected 10-state components. Each component has determinant (1+z³)(1−z−z³), yielding zeta squared and P_n=2S_n+6·1_{3|n}(−1)^(n/3). Symbol-weighted determinant t^4(t³+y)(t³−t²−y) and Perron pressure give two ergodic MME and densities δ=1/[ψ²(3ψ−2)] and 1−δ. Independently enumerated labeled cyclic words through period 11 matching trace counts; published exceptional classification, not the finite check, supports infinite reduction.
residual_risks: Depends critically on the published higher-order minimal antisquare/exceptional-sequence theorem; checker alone cannot establish it.
